briefing: - PAN-OS CVE-2026-0322已入KEV，有在野利用，需立即修复。
- Nginx-UI集中披露4个认证绕过/CSRF等漏洞，尽快升级。
- 本批未见勒索软件关联，但9分以上高危漏洞较多。
- 多个RCE、认证、注入漏洞无PoC，Web与容器风险高。

items.title: PAN-OS 管理接口认证RCE
items.summary_zh: 已认证且具网络访问的攻击者可利用管理接口执行root代码，完全控制防火墙。
items.action_zh: 升级至 PAN-OS 10.2.0/12.2.4 及以上，限制管理接口访问
items.repro_note: 需认证登录管理接口，通过网络访问触发代码执行
items.impact_scope: 边界防火墙管理面，常暴露内网
items.description: A remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in the management interface of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS® software enables an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall. Cloud NGFW and Prisma® Access are not impacted by this vulnerability.

items.title: OpenNMS REST API未授权访问
items.summary_zh: 未授权远程攻击者可访问REST API，读取监控资产并增删改资源、伪造或抑制告警。
items.action_zh: 升级至官方修复版本，限制REST API公网访问
items.repro_note: 未授权调用REST接口读取inventory，或增删改资源注入事件
items.impact_scope: 内网监控平台，管理资产与告警
items.description: An authorization bypass vulnerability exists in the REST API of multiple versions of OpenNMS Meridian and Horizon. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can read the monitored inventory and can create, modify, or delete resources through the REST API, which includes injecting events to fabricate or suppress alarms.

items.title: Nginx-UI 认证绕过访问配置
items.title_zh: Nginx-UI 认证绕过访问配置
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可绕过认证访问配置或MCP接口，未授权修改Nginx配置并执行管理操作。
items.repro_note: 未授权访问/api/config或/mcp路由，利用会话中间件缺失
items.impact_scope: Nginx管理面板，常暴露内网/公网
items.description: Relevant code paths: - [api/config/router.go](/home/kali/Desktop/bounty/nginx-ui/api/config/router.go:14) - [internal/middleware/secure_session.go](/home/kali/Desktop/bounty/nginx-ui/internal/middleware/secure_session.go:52) - [mcp/router.go](/home/kali/Desktop/bounty/nginx-ui/mcp/router.go:9) - [mcp/config/config_add.go](/home/kali/Desktop/bounty/nginx-ui/mcp/config/config_add.go:34) - [mcp/config/config_modify.go](/home/kali/Desktop/bounty/nginx-ui/mcp/config/config_modify.go:55) This is a sec…

items.title: Nginx-UI OAuth登录CSRF
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可诱导受害者完成OAuth回调，使受害者以攻击者身份登录并混淆操作。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复，禁用Casdoor登录或严格校验OAuth state
items.repro_note: OAuth回调未校验state，诱导受害者用攻击者账号登录
items.impact_scope: Nginx管理面板，面向管理用户
items.description: The callback handler accepts whatever `state` the client sends without comparing it to anything stored in the user agent, enabling a login-CSRF: an attacker can force the victim's browser to authenticate as the *attacker*. Attacker initiates a Casdoor authorisation flow on their own browser, obtaining an authorisation `code` for *their* Casdoor account.

items.title: Nginx-UI 配置写入致RCE
items.summary_zh: 已认证攻击者可写入禁用Nginx指令绕过安全层，加载Perl/njs/Lua模块后执行代码。
items.repro_note: 认证后经配置接口写入被禁指令，需已加载njs/Perl/Lua模块
items.impact_scope: Nginx管理面板，控制Web服务器
items.description: An authenticated attacker can exploit this gap to write config files containing any blocked directive (`perl`, `js_import`, `load_module`, `user root`, etc.), bypassing nginx-ui's entire security layer. On a server with the nginx Perl, njs, or Lua module loaded, this is post-authentication Remote Code Execution.

items.title: Nginx-UI MCP输入校验缺失
items.summary_zh: 持有Node密钥或JWT者可通过/mcp接口发送未校验输入，可能触发高权限操作。
items.repro_note: 经/mcp接口发送未校验输入，需X-Node-Secret或JWT
items.impact_scope: Nginx管理面板，MCP接口暴露
items.description: ```python import sys, json, threading, queue, time, http.client BASE = "127.0.0.1:9000" SECRET = "<NODE_SECRET_OR_JWT>" HDR = {"X-Node-Secret": SECRET} # or {"Authorization": "Bearer <JWT>"} resp_q = queue.Queue(); endpoint = {} def sse_reader(): conn = http.client.HTTPConnection(BASE, timeout=60) conn.request("GET", "/mcp", headers={**HDR, "Accept": "text/event-stream"}) r = conn.getresponse(); event = None while True: line = r.fp.readline() if not line: break line = line.decode("utf-8","replac…

items.title: Nginx-UI 加载NJS模块致RCE
items.summary_zh: 认证用户可加载ngx_http_js_module并导入恶意JS，重载Nginx后在worker中执行代码。
items.repro_note: 认证后配置JS模块并重载Nginx，在worker上下文执行NJS
items.impact_scope: Nginx管理面板，控制Web服务器
items.description: In the lab, this allowed the user to load `ngx_http_js_module.so`, import attacker-controlled JavaScript, reload Nginx, and execute NJS in the Nginx worker context. ## Affected component - `/mcp` - `/mcp_message` - MCP tool: `nginx_config_add` - Nginx configuration validation ## Impact A secondary authenticated user can bypass the restricted directive validation enforced by the HTTP API and execute attacker-controlled NJS inside the Nginx worker context.

items.title: Nginx-UI 越权修改管理配置
items.title_zh: Nginx-UI 越权修改管理配置
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可越权修改DNS凭据、证书、备份与S3配置，影响证书签发与数据安全。
items.repro_note: 低权或受害者会话调用管理接口，改DNS/证书/备份配置
items.impact_scope: Nginx管理面板，管证书DNS备份
items.description: Depending on the victim user's privileges and deployment configuration, this can allow the attacker to: - add, edit, or remove DNS provider credentials; - alter certificate and ACME automation; - create, modify, delete, or restore automatic backup jobs; - configure S3 backup destinations and trigger S3 connection tests; - alter DNS domains, records, or DDNS schedules through configured providers; - restart or reload Nginx; - enable/disable stub-status and change performance settings; - switch si…

items.title: mise 不可信仓库命令执行
items.title_zh: mise 不可信仓库命令执行
items.summary_zh: 开发者在恶意仓库运行mise时，攻击者控制解释器可执行任意命令，导致主机失陷。
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·免认证·需用户交互)
items.repro_note: 在不可信仓库执行mise，恶意配置控制解释器命令
items.impact_scope: 开发者主机，供应链入口
items.description: Code execution from an untrusted repository with no trust prompt for the malicious file, on par with the patched CVE. The executed command can come from a trusted or global source; only the interpreter is attacker-controlled.

items.title: Nutanix Prism 认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未授权远程攻击者通过特制内部管理HTTP头绕过认证，完全访问Prism管理API。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，限制Prism管理接口并校验内部头
items.repro_note: 未授权向Prism管理API添加内部管理HTTP头绕过认证
items.impact_scope: 超融合管理面，控集群虚拟机
items.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can bypass authentication and gain full access to administrative API endpoints in Nutanix Prism Element by including a crafted internal management HTTP header. Successful exploitation allows the attacker to execute root-level commands on all Controller VMs (CVMs) in the cluster, leading to complete cluster destruction and unauthorized access to VM memory and virtual disks.

items.title: Special Elements 未授权 SQL注入
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Kitae Park Mang Board WP mangboard allows SQL Injection.This issue affects Mang Board WP: from n/a through 2.4.4.

items.title: WebAssembly 未授权 反序列化(RCE)
items.description: Prior to 0.6.1, containerd-shim-wasmtime-v1 can treat Wasmtime precompiled bytes supplied directly in an OCI image layer as a trusted artifact from the precompile-cache path and deserialize them as native code. An attacker who causes a victim to run a crafted image can bypass WebAssembly validation and execute native code in the shim zygote process, gaining the filesystem, environment, credentials, networking, and Linux syscall access available to the workload container.

items.title: BeyondTrust 未授权 认证欺骗
items.description: The vulnerability exists within internal components of BeyondTrust’s Remote Support product. The components did not adequately validate the origin of the messages it received. Under the right conditions, this could allow an attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

items.title: Nevertheless 未授权 反序列化(RCE)
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: Nevertheless, a malicious or man-in-the-middle DRDA server could craft a response with a 0x50-tagged column, causing the client to deserialize arbitrary attacker-controlled bytes on the Vert.x event loop before any application code can inspect or reject the data.

items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password vulnerability in Mitsubishi Electric GENESIS versions 11.03 and prior, GENESIS64 versions 10.97.3 and prior, ICONICS Suite versions 10.97.3 and prior, Hyper Historian versions 10.97.3 and prior, AnalytiX versions 10.97.3 and prior, MobileHMI 10.97.3 and prior, IoTWorX 10.97.3 and prior, MC Works64 all versions, GENESIS32 all versions, BizViz all versions, Mitsubishi Electric Iconics Digital Solutions GENESIS versions 11.03 and prior, GENESI…

items.title: 未授权 认证欺骗
items.description: Prior to 1.7.4, joserfc.jws.deserialize_json() accepts a JWS General JSON Serialization with an empty signatures array as authenticated. The verify_general_json() loop performs no iterations for the empty array and returns success because no signature check failed, allowing an attacker without a signing key to supply an arbitrary payload that relying applications may treat as authentic.

items.title: Eilik 未授权 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: The EnergizeLab Eilik and EilikO AI skill upload endpoint, served by the FastAPI AI inference and profiling services, does not require authentication and does not constrain uploaded file paths. An unauthenticated remote attacker can use path traversal to write arbitrary files, and thereby tamper with AI skill files used by Eilik and EilikO robots.

items.title: BMC Helix Network Management 未授权 CWE-305
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: BMC Helix Network Management on-prem before 26.3.01 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in as the local administrator with any password when SAML single sign-on is configured. Attackers can submit the administrator username with an arbitrary password on the web login page to obtain a SuperAdmin session, modify device credentials, run device commands, and alter audit records.

items.title: 未明组件 REMOTE_ADDR命令注入
items.title_zh: 未明组件 REMOTE_ADDR命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可操纵REMOTE_ADDR参数注入OS命令，可能导致服务器远程代码执行。
items.action_zh: 升级厂商补丁，过滤REMOTE_ADDR参数并避免拼接命令
items.repro_note: 操纵REMOTE_ADDR参数触发OS命令注入，入口依产品
items.impact_scope: 未知Web服务，可能暴露公网
items.description: The manipulation of the argument REMOTE_ADDR leads to os command injection. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

items.title: 防火墙GeoIP 路径遍历写文件
items.title_zh: 防火墙GeoIP 路径遍历写文件
items.summary_zh: 具别名编辑权限者可配置恶意GeoIP源，解压时路径穿越以root写入任意文件。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，限制GeoIP源URL并收紧别名编辑权限
items.repro_note: 需Firewall Alias Edit权限，配置恶意GeoIP归档含../路径
items.impact_scope: 防火墙管理面，权限用户可写root文件
items.description: A user with Firewall Alias Edit privilege can configure an attacker-controlled GeoIP source URL and supply an archive whose country code traverses into another existing directory, causing attacker-controlled content to be written as root with an -IPv4 or -IPv6 suffix. A crafted newsyslog fragment and oversized log file can use the default hourly root cron job to execute commands as root, resulting in complete firewall compromise.

items.title: Neptune Gremlin反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 具标准数据库权限的远程攻击者可通过Gremlin导入反序列化数据执行代码并窃取凭据。
items.repro_note: 需标准数据库权限，经Gremlin导入恶意序列化数据
items.impact_scope: 云图数据库，可触内网凭据
items.description: Deserialization of untrusted data in the Gremlin graph data import component in Amazon Neptune engine might allow an authenticated remote actor with standard database permissions to execute arbitrary code and access internal service credentials. To remediate this issue, users not enrolled in auto-update should upgrade to Amazon Neptune engine version 1.5.0.0.(Backports to 1.4.8.1 and 1.4.7.1)

items.title: EnergizeLab中间件 任意文件读取
items.title_zh: EnergizeLab中间件 任意文件读取
items.summary_zh: 任意注册低权用户可传入恶意路径读取服务器任意文件，泄露中间件配置与密钥。
items.action_zh: 升级至最新版本，校验文件路径并限制低权访问
items.repro_note: 低权账号传入恶意文件路径，读取服务器任意文件
items.impact_scope: 容器中间件，泄露服务密钥
items.description: EnergizeLab station-middleware (NestJS) Docker images 1.6.5 through 1.8.2 allow any registered, low-privilege account to read arbitrary files from the server by supplying an attacker-controlled file path. This exposes middleware files and server secrets.

items.title: Eilik AI服务 未授权模型管理
items.title_zh: Eilik AI服务 未授权模型管理
items.summary_zh: 未授权远程攻击者可访问FastAPI管理接口，修改AI模型配置并运行时切换模型。
items.action_zh: 限制接口访问并增加认证，升级至修复版本
items.repro_note: 未授权访问FastAPI管理接口，修改或切换AI模型
items.impact_scope: 机器人AI推理服务，常内网
items.description: The EnergizeLab Eilik and EilikO FastAPI AI inference and profiling services expose AI model administration functions without authentication. An unauthenticated remote attacker can change AI model configuration and switch the model in use at runtime.

items.title: Jooan摄像头 硬编码凭据RCE
items.title_zh: Jooan摄像头 硬编码凭据RCE
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者利用硬编码凭据登录，以root执行命令控制IP摄像头。
items.action_zh: 修改默认凭据，限制管理接口，升级固件
items.repro_note: 使用硬编码凭据登录摄像头管理接口，执行root命令
items.impact_scope: IP摄像头，常暴露公网/内网
items.description: Jooan JA-A12 IP cameras with firmware 009_20171107 and 05.02.31.105 contain a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to run root commands via hard-coded credentials. Attackers send singleCMD=SetDiagMode to /goform/SingleHandlebyCommand with an attacker-chosen authserverip and authcode, making the jooandiag daemon execute their commands through /bin/sh, giving full device control.

items.title: Archon 控制API未授权RCE
items.summary_zh: 网络可达攻击者无需认证调用/api，向AI代理发消息并以Archon用户执行主机命令。
items.action_zh: 限制0.0.0.0监听并加认证，升级至修复版本
items.repro_note: 未授权访问/api/*，发消息触发bypassPermissions执行命令
items.impact_scope: AI编码代理，默认绑定0.0.0.0
items.description: Archon 0.2.13 through 0.11.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access the /api/* control API, which binds to 0.0.0.0 by default. Attackers with network access can send messages to the AI coding agent, which runs with bypassPermissions, to execute commands on the host as the Archon user.

items.title: JuggleIM 默认管理员凭据
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者用默认admin/123456登录8090管理台，控制租户应用与密钥。
items.action_zh: 修改默认凭据，限制8090访问，升级修复版本
items.repro_note: 访问8090管理台用admin/123456登录，删除后仍重建
items.impact_scope: IM服务管理台，控租户密钥
items.description: JuggleIM im-server through 1.8.16 ships default administrator credentials admin/123456 that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to access the admin console on port 8090. Attackers can log in as administrator, even after account deletion since CheckLogin recreates it, to control tenant applications and app secrets.

items.title: 路径遍历绕过Token脱敏
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用路径遍历访问/token端点，绕过脱敏读取APIKEY与店铺URL等敏感字段。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，严格规范化路径并保护/token脱敏
items.repro_note: 构造遍历路径访问/token，触发错误序列化绕过脱敏
items.impact_scope: Web API，泄露API密钥
items.description: NetLicensing MCP Server is a natural-language interface that enables agentic applications to manage the software-licensing lifecycle in Labs64 NetLicensing. A traversal segment can be normalized from the intended product path to the /token endpoint, after which the response is serialized through _wrap_json instead of _wrap_json_token_read, bypassing redact_token_read() protections for APIKEY number and SHOP shopURL fields.

items.title: EnergizeLab中间件 越权管理API
items.summary_zh: 低权认证用户可越权访问管理API，窃取AI密钥并修改配置与对象存储内容。
items.action_zh: 升级至最新版本，管理API增加角色校验
items.repro_note: 低权认证用户调用管理API，读取AI密钥并改配置
items.impact_scope: 容器中间件，泄露AI密钥
items.description: EnergizeLab station-middleware (NestJS) Docker images 1.6.5 through 1.8.2 do not check user roles on administrative APIs. Any authenticated low-privilege user can retrieve AI provider keys and change configuration and object-store contents.

items.title: QNAP QuMagie 符号链接漏洞
items.title_zh: QNAP QuMagie 符号链接漏洞
items.summary_zh: 获得用户账号的远程攻击者可利用符号链接跟随，破坏系统安全。

items.action_zh: 升级 QuMagie 至 2.9.2 或更高版本
items.repro_note: 登录后通过文件操作触发符号链接跟随，需普通账号
items.impact_scope: QNAP NAS 应用，内网存储
items.description: An unix symbolic link (symlink) following vulnerability has been reported to affect QuMagie. If a remote attacker gains a user account, they can then exploit the vulnerability to compromise the security of the system. We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version: QuMagie 2.9.2 and later

items.title: QNAP HybridDesk 命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可注入系统命令，执行任意代码，控制 NAS 设备。
items.affected: QNAP(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级 HybridDesk Station 至 4.2.23/4.3.4
items.repro_note: 远程向受影响组件接口注入命令参数触发执行
items.impact_scope: QNAP NAS 组件，内网设备

We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version: HybridDesk Station 4.2.23 and later HybridDesk Station 4.3.4 and later

items.title: Mitsubishi Electric GENESIS64 CWE-266

items.title: SolusVM 2 SSTI 模板注入

items.action_zh: 暂无明确修复版本，限制访问并关注官方更新
items.repro_note: 登录后向模板参数注入 SSTI payload，以 root 执行命令
items.impact_scope: 虚拟化管理面板，控制宿主机
items.description: A server-side template injection exists in SolusVM 2 up to version 2.0.0-44576 that allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary code as root.

items.title: QNAP Qsirch 路径遍历文件读取
items.title_zh: QNAP Qsirch 路径遍历文件读取
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可利用路径遍历读取系统敏感文件，造成信息泄露。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.affected: QNAP(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级 Qsirch 至 7.0.3.0 或更高版本
items.repro_note: 远程构造 ../ 路径参数读取任意文件
items.impact_scope: QNAP NAS 搜索组件，文件泄露
items.description: A path traversal vulnerability has been reported to affect Qsirch. If exploited, the vulnerability could allow remote attackers to read the contents of unexpected files or system data. We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version: Qsirch 7.0.3.0 and later

items.title: EthereumAuth 认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证请求路径包含登录路径时被误判为登录页，可绕过鉴权访问资源。
items.action_zh: 关注厂商修复；临时严格匹配请求路径，勿包含登录路径
items.repro_note: 未授权请求路径后追加密 login path，使鉴权置 ALLOWED
items.impact_scope: EthereumAuth 鉴权应用
items.description: An unauthenticated client may access certain protected resources when using EthereumAuthenticator if the request path contains the configured login path. If the login path appears later within a protected request path, the request may be treated as the login page and its authentication or role requirement replaced with ALLOWED.

items.title: sMedio DTCP MOVE 缺失认证
items.title_zh: sMedio DTCP MOVE 缺失认证
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可未授权访问关键功能，获取系统访问权限。
items.affected: QNAP(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级 sMedio DTCP MOVE 至 1.4.5 或更高
items.repro_note: 未授权调用受影响关键功能接口即可访问系统
items.impact_scope: QNAP NAS 应用，可能公网暴露
items.description: A missing authentication for critical function vulnerability has been reported to affect sMedio DTCP MOVE. If exploited, the vulnerability could allow remote attackers to gain access to the system. We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version: sMedio DTCP MOVE 1.4.5 and later

items.title: TanStack Start 服务端 XSS
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者构造恶意链接，诱使受害者打开，可在应用源执行 JS。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级 TanStack Start 相关包至修复版本
items.repro_note: 构造指向 server function 的 URL，诱导受害者打开触发 XSS
items.impact_scope: TanStack Start 前端应用
items.description: ## Impact An unauthenticated attacker can craft a URL to a server function in an affected TanStack Start app. If someone opens the link, the app can return attacker-controlled HTML from its own origin and run the attacker's JavaScript there.

items.title: Cookie 篡改认证绕过获取 JWT
items.title_zh: Cookie 篡改认证绕过获取 JWT
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者可篡改 Cookie 绕过鉴权，冒充超管获取 JWT。
items.action_zh: 关注厂商修复；临时校验 Cookie 签名与 JWT 权限
items.repro_note: 篡改 Cookie 发送未认证请求，观察是否以超管换取 JWT
items.impact_scope: Cookie/JWT 鉴权 Web 应用
items.description: A remote attacker, without valid credentials or interaction from other users, could manipulate the cookie to bypass authentication checks and impersonate any account, including one with SUPER_ADMIN privileges. This would allow the attacker to obtain a valid JWT token with administrative privileges and compromise the confidentiality and integrity of the application.

items.title: Amelia Booking SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过受影响参数注入 SQL，窃取或篡改数据库数据。
items.action_zh: 暂无明确修复版本，建议停用 Amelia 或限制访问
items.impact_scope: WordPress 站点，数据库泄露
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in TMS Amelia ameliabooking allows SQL Injection.This issue affects Amelia: from n/a through 2.4.10.

items.title: Link Whisper SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过注入盲 SQL，推断并窃取数据库敏感信息。

items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Link Whisper INC Link Whisper Free link-whisper allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects Link Whisper Free: from n/a through 0.9.7.

items.title: Linux Critical
items.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ipv4: validate checksum_start before completing checksum If a packet with bad checksum metadata gets into the ipv4 stack, skb_checksum_help can corrupt the network header and cause a bunch of mischief. We really shouldn't allow such packets in, but as a defence in depth measure, let's also check before we complete the checksum.

items.title: 反序列化(RCE)
items.description: EspoCRM is an open source customer relationship management application. Prior to 9.3.7, an authenticated administrator can supply crafted serialized PHP object data that is stored in background MassAction or Export parameters and later deserialized by the application. The deserialization paths do not restrict allowed classes, allowing attacker-controlled object instantiation and arbitrary code execution on the server. This issue is fixed in version 9.3.7.

items.title: JavaScript CWE-1336
items.description: A workspace administrator can store an evaluate block using the <% code %> form, and the public survey.submit endpoint renders a survey template when an unauthenticated user submits a response. The compiled template executes server-side JavaScript in the Tianji Node.js process, allowing command execution, secret disclosure, data modification, or service disruption.
